summary: Weibo Corporation filed a Form 6-K to publish its second quarter 2026 unaudited financial results as the HK Interim Report under the Hong Kong Listing Rules, including a supplemental disclosure reconciling U.S. GAAP to IFRS amounts. This is a routine financial results filing by a foreign private issuer and does not pertain to any special-situation transaction. No strategic corporate event, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation category applies. The filing is ordinary course reporting with no implications for deal activity.
